about: Bundlephobia shows the bundle-size cost of npm packages. This CLI searches packages and looks up minified/gzipped size, dependency composition, version history, similar packages, exports, recent searches and download/star trends. It can also fetch a GitHub repo's package.json to scan its dependencies.

commands.summary: Autocomplete/search npm package names (npms.io suggestions used by the Bundlephobia search box)

params.name: q
params.description: Search text or package-name prefix; scopes allowed, e.g. '@grida'

commands.summary: Get minified and gzipped bundle size, dependency count and module flags for an npm package (optionally a specific version)

params.name: package
params.description: Package name, optionally with a version: 'react', 'react@19.3.1', '@mui/material'

commands.summary: List a package's recent versions with their bundle sizes and publish dates, plus major/minor release markers

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum number of versions to return (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: Find alternative or similar packages in the same category as a given package
List packages recently searched on Bundlephobia by all users, keyed by package name

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Number of recent packages to return (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: Compare download, star and size trends over time for several packages (the data behind the /trends page)
Fetch the package.json of a GitHub repo (default branch) to list its dependencies for scanning with get-package-size
